ns2:course.label: Financing Emerging Businesses
ns2:course.description: The study of the business environment, alternative methods of organization and financing, use of financial statements as a management tool, valuation methods and approaches to ethical dilemmas from the perspective of an owner-manager. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: FIN 300 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: FIN 300 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Finance or STR BUS DEV & Entrepreneurship major(s). Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: 7-8 sessions will be held on Tuesday or Wednesday evenings. Students receive release from regular class time.
